Cli_Help:
KeyAutomator — keyboard automation

Usage:
  KeyAutomator.exe                 Start the GUI
  KeyAutomator.exe -1              Run ID=1
  KeyAutomator.exe -id 1           Same
  KeyAutomator.exe -alias NAME     Run by alias
  KeyAutomator.exe -NAME           Same (short form)
  KeyAutomator.exe -name "Name"    Run by display name
  KeyAutomator.exe -h              Show this help

Exit codes: 0 success / 1 failure
Log: error.log (writable data folder; if the exe folder is protected, %LocalAppData%\KeyAutomator)

Notes:
  - CLI runs the macro without the management window
  - Macros with a confirm (dialog) action still show a message box in CLI
    (this is not fully unattended)
